blocks.text: Another free day by the ocean. Stay on one of the beaches, spend the day at waterfront restaurants or continue exploring the resort's different bays. There is no scheduled excursion, so you can set your own pace after the busy Rio portion of the trip and the journey to the coast. If you spent the previous day on the water, you can devote this one entirely to the beach; if you feel like being active, the same options remain available: a boat trip, snorkelling, diving or exploring the resort.
